# Nebius hikes AI cloud prices again as demand for computing power soars

 By Thomson Reuters Sep 17, 2026 | 11:16 AM 

Sept 17 (Reuters) – Cloud provider Nebius said on Thursday it will raise pay-as-you-go prices for leasing selected ​Nvidia chips from October 1, ‌marking the company’s second price hike in three months.

Demand for computing capacity to train and run AI models is surging; rival CoreWeave ‌said ​earlier in the ⁠day that it is ⁠signing contracts at higher prices.

Here are some details:

• Rates for selected Nvidia graphics processing units will rise between ​17% and 21%.

• On-demand rates for some central processing units, made ⁠by AMD and Intel, ⁠and memory offerings have also ​been hiked.

• Prices of some CPU-only instances ​will rise by 25% and those ‌of memory offerings by about 41%, the company said.

• The Amsterdam-based neocloud firm said that customers reserving large-scale clusters ⁠for multiple months can receive commitment discounts.

• Nebius’ price increases follow a quarter of rapid ⁠growth ‌in its AI cloud business, ⁠as the company signed four ​customer ‌contracts averaging more than $1 billion ​each.

• Neocloud ⁠firms like Nebius rent out high-powered chips and data center infrastructure needed for AI models.

If bookings hold at the new card, scarcity is confirmed and asset-backed finance gets cheaper to roll forward. If they flinch, the slowdown chorus gets its data point and the risk shifts from customers to lenders. One warning light I could not check: bears cite secondhand accelerator prices as the earliest signal of capex trouble, and no published index I could reach this week carries that number: the organized market for used GPUs↗ itself only opened on 17 July 10. That leaves the rate card as the cleanest public signal available.

When essays and price lists disagree, believe the price list, then verify it. Three markers after 1 October: on-demand utilization at the new rates, whether the next capacity auction again clears above the last, and whether Nebius funds its 2027 build from customer prepayments rather than another equity raise 7. results.title: Nebius Is Raising Prices For Nvidia GPU Cloud Access - Finimize
results.author: Finimize Newsroom
highlights:
The neocloud firm will lift pay-as-you-go rates 17%-21% from October 1st, as demand for AI computing keeps tightening supply.

2 mins

What's going on here?

Nebius, a neocloud provider that rents Nvidia graphics processing units (GPUs) through its AI cloud, says it’ll raise pay-as-you-go prices for some chips on October 1st – its second hike in three months.

What does this mean?

“Neoclouds” sit between Big Tech clouds and companies that would rather not build their own data centers: they bundle scarce AI chips and the infrastructure to run them, then rent that capacity out. Nebius said rates for selected Nvidia GPUs will rise 17%-21%; it’s also lifting prices for some CPU-only, memory, AMD, and Intel offerings. The timing is telling: demand for AI computing is still outpacing supply, and CoreWeave, a rival AI cloud pro..

ud provider, said it’s signing contracts at higher prices too.

When on-demand rates jump, customers face a clearer trade-off between flexibility and certainty. Nebius is leaning into that by offering commitment discounts to clients that reserve large clusters for multiple months, which effectively turns “metered” cloud spending into capacity booked in advance. For providers, that swap can mean slightly less upside from peak pricing, but better utilization and more predictable revenue and cash flow – especially if big buyers keep locking in multi-year deals.

要点

- 云基础设施提供商Nebius宣布将从10月1日起上调其按需GPU云服务价格，受此消息提振，其股价在盘前交易中大涨。此举被市场解读为人工智能算力需求持续强劲的信号，凸显了公司的定价能力和利润前景。
- 云基础设施提供商Nebius Group NV (NBIS) 宣布将再次上调其云服务价格，受此消息提振，其股价在盘前交易中飙升11.1%。市场将此举视为人工智能 (AI) 算力需求持续超越供给的直接证据，从而强化了对该公司定价能力和利润前景的乐观预期。
- 值得注意的是，这已是Nebius在短短几个月内进行的第二轮提价。经过连续上调后，B300 GPU实例的费率累计涨幅已达到约56%。这一系列举措凸显了议价能力正向云基础设施提供商倾斜的结构性转变，此前分析师已将此动态视为“新云”板块的关键长期利好因素。

## 价格上调细节

根据Nebius向客户发出的通知，新价格将于2026年10月1日起生效，涵盖了其主要的按需GPU云服务。此次价格上调的具体范围包括：

- H100实例：上涨约17%
- 最新的Nvidia B300 GPU实例：上涨约21%
- AMD EPYC Genoa CPU费率：上涨25%

值得注意的是，这已是Nebius在短短几个月内进行的第二轮提价。经过连续上调后，B300 GPU实例的费率累计涨幅已达到约56%。这一系列举措凸显了议价能力正向云基础设施提供商倾斜的结构性转变，此前分析师已将此动态视为“新云”板块的关键长期利好因素。
